High impact promo slider showcasing Signature Brownie Combos, Fresh Birthday Cakes, and Festival Gift Hampers with direct CTA buttons

Pathankot customer reviews & ratings with star indicators and cake order verification tag

component_guidelines.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-rose text-white hover:bg-rose-deep rounded-md transition-colors shadow-sm font-medium. Secondary buttons: bg-sand text-ink hover:bg-rose-light hover:text-rose border border-rose/20 rounded-md.
component_guidelines.cards: Product cards with white background, subtle border border-rose/10, soft shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow rounded-xl overflow-hidden p-3 md:p-4
component_guidelines.badge_system: Eggless: green square badge with circle inside; Non-Veg / Egg: red square badge with circle inside; Discount tag: bg-rose text-white text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold
component_guidelines.modals: Custom Cake Builder Modal and Quick View Modal with smooth entrance animation and dark semi-transparent overlay (bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs)
component_guidelines.data_testid: ALL interactive components, inputs, buttons, filter tabs, and cart controls MUST have clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='category-tab-cakes')

motion_and_interactions.cart_drawer: Slide-in drawer from right side on clicking cart button with item counter, quantity adjustment (+/-), apply coupon code, delivery time selector, and checkout trigger
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast notifications upon adding items to cart, copying coupon code, or submitting custom cake inquiries
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Image zoom on hover in product cards, elevation shift (-translate-y-1) on promo banners

instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Tailwind CSS with custom rose, cream, sand, and ink color variables defined in tailwind.config.js and index.css
instructions_to_main_agent.interactive_state: Implement full cart state management (add, remove, update quantity, apply promo codes like USB800 and COMBO15), custom cake order submission flow with step guidance, store pickup vs doorstep delivery switch, search modal, and checkout confirmation modal with Cash on Delivery / UPI options

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or semi-opaque background with blur.
